::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A national manufacturing-innovation center approved by MIIT (October 2017), led by Accelink under CICT; its 12-inch silicon-photonics tape-out platform commissioned in Optics Valley in November 2025 — running on a fully domestic toolset (announced September 2025) with a commercial-grade 40nm PDK — makes it the only national-level platform for domesticized optoelectronic chip wafer R&D.
:::

**Chinese name:** 武汉光谷信息光电子创新中心有限公司（国家信息光电子创新中心） (Guójiā Xìnxī Guāngdiànzǐ Chuàngxīn Zhōngxīn)

## What does this facility make?

Optical-communication and opto-AI chips on 200/300mm wafers: demo silicon-photonic interconnect chips (1.6T, 2T chiplet), 170GHz thin-film-lithium-niobate modulator (March 2026), MPW shuttle services for 300+ organizations.

## Why does it matter?

Silicon photonics is China's most credible 'bypass' strategy for AI-interconnect bottlenecks; Hubei's stated 2030 target is a global-top-3 12-inch SiPh specialty line. This platform de-risks that flow from overseas fabs.

## Project Timeline

- **Oct 2017** — MIIT approves the national manufacturing innovation center (挂牌 April 2018)
- **Sep 2025** — First fully-domesticized silicon-photonics 'toolkit' (PDK/TDK/ADK) released
- **Nov 2025** — 12-inch SiPh tape-out platform commissioned in Optics Valley
- **May 2026** — Selected into MIIT's second-batch national key pilot-platform list
